mapper.select: SELECT w.id FROM worker w LEFT JOIN repair_order r ON w.id = r.worker_id AND r.status IN (1, 2) WHERE w.is_available = 1 GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT w.name AS workerName, COUNT(r.id) AS completedCount FROM worker w LEFT JOIN repair_order r ON w.id = r.worker_id AND r.status = 3 GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY completedCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT w.id FROM worker w LEFT JOIN repair_order ro ON w.id = ro.worker_id AND ro.status IN (1, 2) WHERE w.is_available = 1 AND (w.skills LIKE CONCAT('%', #{repairType}, '%') OR #{repairType} REGEXP REPLACE(w.skills, ',', '|')) GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY COUNT(ro.id) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM worker
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worker (username, password, name, phone, skills, is_available, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{skills}, #{isAvailable}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
